revision_plan.purpose: Use v2 failures as prior evidence for a new LLM research cycle, then evaluate exactly one frozen revision on new data; this is not an independent replication of the original discovery process.

calibration.sampling: independent uniformly random scenario for each case, not fixed balanced counts

coverage.sampling: independent uniformly random scenario for each case, not fixed balanced counts

methods.revision_selected: Exactly one method frozen by runs/revision_reference before generating any fresh dataset
methods.ablation_policy: For composed selected specs, apply these declared changes. K3/K4 are a paired selection-fold contrast; if selected is not CV they also enable CV, so do not call them single-component ablations of selected. Baseline shorthand has no compositional ablations. Normalize defaults and ignore cv_folds for non-CV when marking exact aliases; aliases reuse numerical predictions and are not independent methods.

statistics.paired_endpoint: reference error minus revision_selected error, positive favours revision; use identical case IDs
statistics.strata_weight: equal weight per predeclared balanced cell; resample paired cases within each fixed cell
statistics.confidence_intervals: two-sided percentile 95%; descriptive approximate sampling intervals, no multiplicity adjustment or uncertainty from LLM search

static_noninferiority.endpoint: ratio of mean errors and mean(selected error minus 1.1*WLS error)
static_noninferiority.interpretation: point estimate and two-sided 95% bootstrap upper bound reported separately; exploratory noninferiority diagnostic, not a confirmatory trial

statistics.per_seed: Report each of the three main root seeds; these are data batches, not independent LLM research replications
statistics.cost_caveat: Legacy work_units is solver nfev; composed solver work_units counts residual calls including CV/initialization rounds. They are not guaranteed identical compute units. Report wall time as observed machine timing, not a controlled speed benchmark; no direct acceleration claim from work-unit ratios.
statistics.failures: Report every predefined scenario and n-boundary cell, including deterioration; no choice of favourable evaluation version or subset

regions.score: Euclidean position error divided by frozen positive observation-only geometry_scale_m, clipped/fallback exactly as the original scale(row) helper
regions.global: k=ceil((m+1)*(1-alpha)); kth calibration score, infinity if k>m or m=0
regions.mondrian: Same rank independently within a frozen observation-derived selected_model group: static or velocity (legacy dynamic is mapped to velocity). Unknown output raises an error, never truth-based fallback.
regions.empty_group: Use an unbounded region and q=infinity. JSON stores string infinity and explicit unbounded indicators, not null.
regions.subgroups: Report true scenario only after prediction as evaluation labels; true scenario is not the Mondrian group function
regions.coverage_intervals: Wilson 95% intervals for the IID test population and its scenario/observed-model subgroups. They estimate test-sampling coverage probability conditional on this realized calibration rule, not a conformal guarantee or recalibration interval. No pooled binomial interval for fixed-mixture shifted stress/edge.
regions.guarantee_scope: IID calibration/test plus frozen estimator/scale/group implies marginal global coverage and group-conditional Mondrian coverage conditional on group membership and calibration group count, marginal over calibration scores. No guarantee conditional on a realized calibration set, true scenario, radius acceptance, or shifted stress/edge population.

integrity.original_v2_sources: Preserve every original frozen byte. New study uses separate files and includes original and new sources in its initialization hash manifest.
integrity.case_identity: Prefix split, root seed and case index; retain generator_seed in case metadata. Identical case object across methods.
integrity.output_policy: Refuse existing output directory. Save initialization provenance, input cases, every unique method result, aliases, complete statistics and completion marker.
integrity.fresh_results_policy: Never generate these fresh datasets or inspect their outcomes before revision freeze. Fixtures use unrelated small seeds only. Old v2 test data are acknowledged prior evidence, never relabelled fresh holdout.
